subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The _______________ nature of the proposal led to extensive discussions and debates among the committee members.
solution:
The correct answer is '**contentious**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**contentious**" means likely to cause disagreement or argument. (विवादास्पद)
 
• In the given sentence, the proposal's nature resulted in extensive discussions and debates, which aligns perfectly with the meaning of "contentious."
 
• The other options: "**simplistic**," "**agreeable**," and "**transparent**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The contentious__ nature of the proposal led to extensive discussions and debates among the committee members.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Simplistic (सरल)**: means treating complex issues in an overly simplified manner.
 
• **Agreeable (सुखद)**: means being pleasant or acceptable.
 
• **Transparent (पारदर्शी)**: means being open and easily understood.
